description: This file defines the BitState class used for managing bit positions within configuration fields, including methods for incrementing, resetting, and retrieving the current bit index.

classes.name: BitState
classes.description: A class for tracking the current bit index, with functionality to increment, reset, and retrieve the index position.

methods.name: incrementBitIndex
methods.description: Increments the bit index if the current configuration field is a bit; resets to zero otherwise; throws an exception if the index exceeds 31.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the bit index to zero.
